verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data platform, but the evidence pack never documents any way to opt out of Hightouch's own telemetry or usage tracking. The Events SDKs are tracking tools Hightouch provides to its customers, not an opt-out. The community note that data stays in the customer's warehouse is an adjacent privacy property, not a telemetry control, so it earns no credit.
